title: Alfa Watan sinks off Bulgaria as India reports 12 injured on On Peace
excerpt: Togo-flagged general cargo ship sinks in Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone on 6 October; India says 11 of the 12 injured on On Peace, hit on 5 October, are its nationals.
x_post: Togo-flagged Alfa Watan sank off Bulgaria on 6 October, crew missing; India says 11 of 12 injured on On Peace, hit on 5 October, are its nationals. #MaritimeSecurity #BlackSea #StraitOfHormuz #Seafarers

Key point on Alfa Watan: credited the confirmation to Bulgaria's prime minister and government, not the government alone.

On Peace was struck by an unknown projectile at 1637 UTC on 5 October per UKMTO, which reported an engine room fire and at first no casualties; say it was hit on 5 October and that the injuries were reported on 6 October.
The 12 injured (11 of them Indian) come from India's government, never from UKMTO: credit the injury figure to India in the headline, standfirst, key points, article and tweet.
Do not say India condemned the attack on the Marshall Islands-flagged vessel off Odesa or that Indian nationals were injured on it; no source ties India's statement to that ship.
Aframax Rio paragraph: say once that the crew was rescued, among them 23 Indian crew members, with no injuries reported; do not say the whole crew was Indian.

Lead with the Alfa Watan sinking off Bulgaria on 6 October (crew missing), the most serious attack in this period; put On Peace second, plainly as a 5 October attack whose injuries were reported on 6 October, and do not repeat the lede in the Hormuz section.
